summary: Raise the alternatives first-pass limit to 20

added.name: First-pass limit applies while items lack a check
added.text: While at least one open item has no check, the alternatives row SHALL check at most `roadmap.alternatives.first_pass_limit` items in a round.

scenarios.name: 25 open items have no check
scenarios.when: The alternatives row runs and 25 open items have no check
scenarios.then: The row checks at most 20 items in that round

added.name: Recheck limit applies when all items have a check
added.text: When every open item has a check, the alternatives row SHALL check at most `roadmap.alternatives.limit` items in a round.

scenarios.name: All open items have a check
scenarios.when: The alternatives row runs and every open item already has a check
scenarios.then: The row checks at most 5 items in that round
